text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan claimed victory in the 
Kikuka-sho. Ines Fujin collapsed from 
exhaustion after the race, and upon 
waking, she was filled with regret.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She learned the truth during her visit 
home: to support their older sister's 
dream, her younger sisters had quit dance 
class to take care of the housework in 
place of their frail mother.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To clear her younger sisters' worries, 
Ines Fujin had taken on extra shifts and 
struggled to change her running style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's easy to say she should have just 
talked to us. But she likely bottled it up 
on her own to avoid making everyone else 
worry unnecessarily.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin's worries are my worries. 
Promising to solve them together, we set 
our sights on the "Osaka Hai" with time to 
spare.
